name: @jacksonw111/better-agent-bridge
description: Better Agent client CLI — pairs a computer to a Better Agent server, reports runtime/skill/tool inventory, launches task runs in managed workspaces, and relays local coding agents (claude-code, opencode, codex, pi) over oRPC.

scripts.compile: scripts/build-broker.sh darwin-arm64 .broker-build/pty-broker && node scripts/embed-broker.mjs darwin-arm64 .broker-build/pty-broker && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 ./src/index.ts --outfile agent-cli; node scripts/embed-broker.mjs --restore
